values.note: Single site $15, double $25, group $50 (0-50 people) or $100 (51-74). In the 2027 first-come weeks at either end of the season, singles are $11 and doubles $22. Extra fees for parking and the boat ramp; day use $5 per vehicle.

fees.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r09/marktwain/recreation/council-bluff-recreation-area ('Forest Service Overnight Fees: Single Site: $15 per night Double Site: $25 per night Group Site: $50 per night for 0-50 people; $100 per night for 51-74 people'; 'Concessionaire Day Use: $5 per vehicle') + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/232325/rates (2027: First-come, First-served Season 04-24 to 05-19 and 09-27 to 10-30 Walk InSTANDARD NONELECTRIC $11, (u20) $22; Peak Season 05-20 to 09-26 $15/$25) + notices ('Additional fees are charged for parking', '...for use of the boat ramp'), read 2026-11-09

hookups.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/232325 ('Electricity is not available') + https://www.recreation.gov/api/search/campsites?fq=asset_id%3A232325 (no site lists an electric, water or sewer hookup), read 2026-11-09

values.note: 39 single and 7 double sites on one loop, 9 walk-in tent sites and 4 group sites (up to 50 people). RVs up to 40 ft fit at most sites; recreation.gov lists the loop sites at 30-40 ft. Two vehicles per site; 8 people per single site, 16 per double.

sites.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r09/marktwain/recreation/council-bluff-recreation-area ('No. of Sites Single: 39 Double: 7 Walk-in: 9 ... Group: 4'; 'RVs up to 40 feet will fit at most sites. Check recreation.gov for specific length restrictions.'; 'Campsite parking allows for two vehicles per site'; 'No more than 8 people are permitted at single sites (16 for double sites)') + https://www.recreation.gov/api/search/campsites?fq=asset_id%3A232325 (Max Vehicle Length 30-40 on standard sites; 26, 28, 30, 32D, 34 at 40), read 2026-11-09

values.note: The campground water system is out of service; water, flush toilets and coin-operated showers are at Chapel Hill Beach about a mile away when it opens for the season (closed Mondays except holiday weekends). Swim beach, two boat ramps, picnic pavilion, 12-mile lake trail.

values.note: 2026 dates; recreation.gov lists 2027 sites from April 24 through October 30.

values.note: Reserve at least 3 days ahead; group sites up to 12 months ahead. Some sites stay first-come, and in 2027 every site is first-come Apr 24 - May 19 and Sep 27 - Oct 30.

booking.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r09/marktwain/recreation/council-bluff-recreation-area ('Reservations can be made up to 6 months in advance of visit for single sites.'; '...12 months in advance of a visit for group sites.'; 'Reservations must be made at least 3 days in advance of visit.') + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/232325 ('Some sites are available on a first-come, first-served basis'; rules minHolidayWeekendStay 3) + rates (2027 First-come seasons 04-24 to 05-19 and 09-27 to 10-30, Peak 05-20 to 09-26) + availability (April and May 1-19 2027 'Not Reservable', NYR from 05-20), read 2026-11-09

note: Mark Twain National Forest campground (Wild Boar Ridge) on a wooded ridge above 440-acre Council Bluff Lake near Belgrade; the lake, Chapel Hill Beach and boat ramps are about a mile's walk or a short drive away. Sites are screened by trees and brush. --Claude
summary: FS + rec.gov read: 59 sites (39 single, 7 double, 9 walk-in, 4 group), no hookups, 40-ft max at most sites, open Apr 23 - Nov 1 2026, $15 single / $25 double ($11/$22 in the 2027 first-come weeks), reservable mid-season with some FCFS. Campground water system out of service. WATERFRONT: lakeview -> NOT WATERFRONT (campground is 140 m+ from the lake through full forest on a ridge). Pin is 1.5 km S of the campground: move. Phone flagged.
flags: WATERFRONT (stored lakeview -> not waterfront, downgrade). The rec.gov catalog puts every campsite at 37.720-37.727 N on a forested ridge; the 0.94 m/px leaf-off frame puts the nearest one (032D, at the loop's east end) ~140 m from the lake's north arm through unbroken forest, and the rest 250 m+. FS: 'the campground and beach are about a 1 mile hike apart' and 'The sites are screened with trees and brush'. No page claims a lake view from any site. Unsure goes down.

PIN: stored 37.7083,-90.9417 = the rec.gov facility point, ~1.5 km S of the campground (all catalog sites are 37.720-37.727 N, -90.928 to -90.940). Suggest moving to the middle of the loop by the group sites, 37.7230,-90.9370.
PHONE: rec.gov lists (573) 766-5765, which the FS page names as the concessionaire's line for pavilion reservations. The entry has no phone; add 573-766-5765 by hand if wanted.
WATER: the campground water system is out of service (FS current conditions); potable_water not written. Stored note 'seasonal water' in inclusion_evidence is out of date.
SEASON: FS 'Open April 23 to November 1, 2026' written (opens 04-23, closes 11-01), replacing the derived Apr-Oct. 2027 rec.gov seasons run 04-24 to 10-30.
28-ft/40-ft: FS 'RVs up to 40 feet will fit at most sites'; catalog lengths 30-40 ft on the loop sites, so max_rig_ft 40 stays.
SITE COUNT: FS gives 39 single + 7 double + 9 walk-in + 4 group = 59; rec.gov lists only 28 loop sites, 10 walk-to and 4 group, so not every FS site is in the catalog.
Note rewritten: setting and distance to the lake; counts, season, fees and booking are now in the fields.
